levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
جعفر بن محمد بن عبد الله

notes: «وبهذا الإسناد» takes over the whole written chain of prev1 (has_written_chain true), so the six names are inherited first and no back_reference is written for the same phrase
the Imam who speaks («فقال: بل ائذنوا له») is one of the two named in «أبي عبد الله ... أو أبي جعفر»; the text does not settle which, so both stand as alternatives
